mentions.h: Southern Road-Relay — BELS BACK IN THE MEDALS — BELGRAVE & SOUTHERN COUNTIES AAA ROAD RELAY---8th April 1972

photos.c: BACK COVER (Photo by Ed.Lacey)--Geoff North and Beevor(Herc/Wim) lead an impressive bunch early in the National Championships at Sutton Coldfield. Following up are Cox, Adcocks, Turner, Moxom, Ashton, D. Holt and Hogan.
